counterexamples.finding: General function approximation is conditional on bounded finite-complexity classes, realizability/completeness and coverage; offline robust all-policy concentrability vs hybrid single-policy transfer require different structural assumptions. TV branch uses fail state; hybrid requires bilinear model and nominal online/offline access. No benchmark or numerical theorem value is required for this theory-only paper.

Thm5 exposes approximation term O((sqrt epsF,r+epsG)K^2.5 H); sqrtK regret and eps^-2 mixture complexity need zero/suitably shrinking approximation error, not merely fixed small positive error and more samples. Mixture guarantee differs from last policy. Author notes horizon/dimension factors not minimax optimal. ERM/LS oracle tractability is not arbitrary neural-network polynomial runtime.

Prop3 KL generator printed quadratic vs proof t log t; CVaR indicator convention/differentiability needs checking. Prop4 bounded-loss general ERM proof asserts Bernstein variance control from symmetrization without a clear sufficient condition; generic boundedness alone does not justify fast O(1/N). Cor5 positive fixed approximation error grows with K after averaging, so cannot be ≤eps for all sufficiently large K without added error control. Treat as unresolved condition queries, not a certified refutation or a stylistic norm.

Stray gamma in finite-H equation; transfer definition numerator vs proof positive part; inverse lambda/radius mapping asserted for TV should not become universal penalty/constraint equivalence. Impact boilerplate is this author choice, not official template text.
